# FG-LLM-0002

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 502 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`llm-advice-quality`](../../ops/runbooks/llm-advice-quality.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `invalid_output_retried_once_then_error` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: AI の助言を作れませんでした（AI の答えが決まった形になっていません）。助言なしで続けられます。
- en: The AI advice could not be made (the AI's answer was not in the required shape). You can continue without it.
- id: Saran AI tidak dapat dibuat (jawaban AI tidak dalam bentuk yang diwajibkan). Anda dapat melanjutkan tanpanya.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 19 §2 (ADR-0039): the local model answered a request twice with something that is not the advice's JSON shape (`forge_core::llm::check_output`): not JSON, not an object, `summary` missing or not text, `findings` not a list or a finding with a bad `severity` / `path` / `line` / `quote` / `message` / `confidence`, a bad `deep_review`, or more than 100 findings. The first invalid answer is retried once with a note; the second is this code. The advice is not written: a check built on it is `error`, never success (ADR-0003), and the screens fall back to the view without AI.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The gateway logs `forge.llm.request_finished` with `error_code=FG-LLM-0002`, `purpose`, `llm_request_id`, `model`, `prompt_version`, `reason` (the second answer's) and `first_reason`, `attempts=2`; the metric `forge_llm_output_invalid_total{purpose}` counts them. Read the request row: SELECT purpose, model, prompt_id, prompt_version, input_tokens, output_tokens, state, error_code FROM forge.llm_requests WHERE id = <llm_request_id>. A run of them after a model or prompt change is the change's fault.

## 対処 (fix)

Single failures need nothing (the next request runs normally). A run of them: roll the prompt version or the model back (runbook llm-advice-quality / llm-model-update), and add the failing shape to the purpose's eval set before changing the prompt again.
